item.title: Feeding America’s economy: Why agriculture still matters | AGDAILY
item.description: As we mark National Ag Day and the release of the 10th Feeding the Economy report, the strength of American agriculture is inseparable from the strength of the American economy.

item.description: Record-breaking bids at the 2026 Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo steer auction, including a $1.5 million champion sale.

item.title: Women farmers are underestimated the world over -- and it’s holding us all back | AGDAILY
item.description: Throughout history, women have been the primary stewards of the land. Now, our vital role in feeding communities deserves recognition and celebration.

item.title: After activist threats, WSU pulls the plug on equine surgery lab | AGDAILY
item.description: WSU’s cancellation of its equine surgery lab due to safety threats has sparked debate over animal welfare, activist influence, and hands-on training.

item.title: Farmers receive less than 6 cents of the food dollar | AGDAILY
item.description: In 2024, U.S. farmers and ranchers received just 5.8 cents of every food dollar --highlighting a continued decline in farm-level value.

item.title: Rural Minds launches free farmer mental health program | AGDAILY
item.description: Rural Minds has launched a free, confidential online mental health program to support farmers amid growing stress and suicide risks in agriculture.

item.title: Hidden costs of farming and what the public doesn't see | AGDAILY
item.description: There are so many costs associated with food products that consumers may not realize, which can impact grocery prices both positively and negatively.

item.title: Kentucky farm family rejects anonymous $26M data center offer | AGDAILY
item.description: A Kentucky farm family rejected a $26 million data center offer, underscoring rising tensions between farmland preservation and AI expansion.
